LanguageData.LP_Bs_WoodElfChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] learned to draw a bow at the same time as learning to walk. Every oak in the old forest knows [PAWN_nameDef], and the deer never shy away from [PAWN_objective].
LanguageData.LP_Bs_WoodElfChild.title: little hunter of the old forest
LanguageData.LP_Bs_WoodElfWarden.description: [PAWN_nameDef] guarded the old forest's border for a full century: loggers, poachers and lost orcs all turned back under [PAWN_possessive] arrows.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_WoodElfWarden.title: woodland warden
LanguageData.LP_Bs_DrowHouseChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born in the spider-web tower of a drow house in the Underdark. There, the first thing a child learns is never to trust their siblings, and the second is how to poison a blade.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_DrowHouseChild.title: youngest child of Menzoberranzan
LanguageData.LP_Bs_DrowRenegade.description: [PAWN_nameDef] had enough of the schemes of Lolth's priestesses and fled to the surface with a poisoned short sword. The sunlight hurts [PAWN_possessive] eyes, but it beats going back.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_DrowRenegade.title: traitor who fled the Spider Queen
LanguageData.LP_Bs_HillDwarfChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a hill dwarf wine cellar, could tell thirty malts apart at ten, and drank [PAWN_possessive] father under the table at twelve.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_HillDwarfChild.title: child of a hill brewery
LanguageData.LP_Bs_HillDwarfShieldbearer.description: [PAWN_nameDef] stood in the hill dwarf shield wall for decades and took more sword cuts than others have seen. [PAWN_pronoun] never says "I'm tired", only "another round".
LanguageData.LP_Bs_HillDwarfShieldbearer.title: hill shieldguard
LanguageData.LP_Bs_LightfootChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] traveled the whole Sword Coast with the family caravan, made friends at every market, and pinched a honey cake at every market too.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_LightfootChild.title: caravan halfling
LanguageData.LP_Bs_LightfootWanderer.description: [PAWN_nameDef] wanders far and wide on a quick tongue and a bag of spices. When trouble comes, [PAWN_pronoun] always finds someone big to stand in front.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_LightfootWanderer.title: lightfoot peddler
LanguageData.LP_Bs_StoutChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a round-doored burrow house at the foot of a hill, eating six meals a day and sleeping until the sun was high. The family garden was the best in the village.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_StoutChild.title: burrow cottage child
LanguageData.LP_Bs_StoutInnkeeper.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s inn is famous for its stew and ale. Every dwarf who visits says it's the most homelike place on the surface, and [PAWN_pronoun] never stops repeating it.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_StoutInnkeeper.title: stout innkeeper
LanguageData.LP_Bs_RockGnomeChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] took the family clock apart at five and put it back together at six, with two parts left over. Since then everything in the house that moves has been modified by [PAWN_objective].
LanguageData.LP_Bs_RockGnomeChild.title: gnome in the gear pile
LanguageData.LP_Bs_RockGnomeTinker.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s clockwork beetles fly, clockwork puppies bark and clockwork locks curse at thieves. It's just that half of them explode the first time they are wound up.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_RockGnomeTinker.title: clockwork artisan
LanguageData.LP_Bs_ForestGnomeChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s childhood playmates were a badger and three squirrels. Forest gnome villages hide behind illusions; outsiders never find them.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_ForestGnomeChild.title: gnome of the hollow tree
LanguageData.LP_Bs_ForestGnomeFriend.description: [PAWN_nameDef] protects the woods with little illusions: making hunters see bears that aren't there, and leading lost children home by fireflies.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_ForestGnomeFriend.title: woodland illusionist
LanguageData.LP_Bs_DeepGnomeChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a city without sunlight. The first thing [PAWN_pronoun] learned was to press against the stone wall motionless until the drow patrol passed.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_DeepGnomeChild.title: child of Underdark miners
LanguageData.LP_Bs_DeepGnomeGemcutter.description: [PAWN_nameDef] can hear which stone hides a gem. When [PAWN_pronoun] fled to the surface, [PAWN_pronoun] carried only an uncut sapphire and a belly full of distrust.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_DeepGnomeGemcutter.title: svirfneblin gem cutter
LanguageData.LP_Bs_HalfElfChild.description: Elves thought [PAWN_nameDef] grew up too fast; humans thought too slowly. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to say nice things to both sides, and to take neither side too seriously.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_HalfElfChild.title: child between two peoples
LanguageData.LP_Bs_HalfElfEnvoy.description: For years [PAWN_nameDef] ran errands and carried messages between human city-states and the elven court, settling three border disputes that nearly came to war. Neither side can do without [PAWN_objective], and neither fully trusts [PAWN_objective].
LanguageData.LP_Bs_HalfElfEnvoy.title: border envoy
LanguageData.LP_Bs_KoboldWarrenChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] hatched from an egg. The first thing [PAWN_pronoun] saw was a pile of gold, the second a dragon sleeping on it. From then on [PAWN_pronoun] knew what to live for.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_KoboldWarrenChild.title: egg in the dragon's lair
LanguageData.LP_Bs_KoboldTrapper.description: [PAWN_nameDef] buried something in every tunnel of the dragon's lair: spike pits, falling rocks, tripwires, jars full of bees. Adventurers hate [PAWN_objective], but the dragon loves [PAWN_objective].
LanguageData.LP_Bs_KoboldTrapper.title: kobold trapmaker
LanguageData.LP_Bs_GoblinCampChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a goblin warband's camp, fighting for scraps, dodging whips and secretly watching hobgoblins drill. Every goblin brat who survives is sharp.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_GoblinCampChild.title: warband camp brat
LanguageData.LP_Bs_GoblinoidLegion.description: [PAWN_nameDef] once served in the ranks of a hobgoblin legion and saw too many comrades used as stepping stones for sieges. One rainy night [PAWN_pronoun] threw down the banner and ran.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_GoblinoidLegion.title: legion deserter
LanguageData.LP_Bs_BugbearAmbusher.description: [PAWN_nameDef] can crouch in the tree shadows all day just to wait for a lone wagon. Bugbears are lazy, but never when it comes to an ambush.
LanguageData.LP_Bs_BugbearAmbusher.title: forest road ambusher
